address.description: Start address ($HHHH or decimal) Limits depend on op.

length.description: Number of bytes to scan Limits depend on op.

stride.description: Stride between sprite candidates in bytes

minSetBits.description: Minimum number of set bits required

pauseDuringRead.description: Pause the machine during memory read

scanRange.description: Range to scan if address not provided: 'common' or 'full'

outputPath.description: File path to write charset binary Limits depend on op.

includeContainers.description: Include container images (d64/d81/etc.) in extension stats

maxSamplesPerExtension.description: Number of sample paths to keep per extension

description:
Extraction operations available via the c64_extract tool.

Operations:
- sprites: Scan RAM for sprites and optionally export .spr files. Required inputs: address, length. Optional inputs: stride, maxSprites, minNonZeroRows, minSetBits, includeBase64, outputDir, pauseDuringRead.
- charset: Locate and extract 2KB character sets from RAM. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: address, scanRange, outputPath, pauseDuringRead, minNonEmptyChars, minEntropy.
- memory_dump: Dump a RAM range to hex or binary files with manifest metadata. Required inputs: address, length, outputPath. Optional inputs: format, chunkSize, pauseDuringRead, retries.
- fs_stats [c64u, u2]: Walk the filesystem and aggregate counts/bytes by extension. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, extensions, includeContainers, maxSamplesPerExtension.
- firmware_health: Run firmware readiness checks and report status metrics. Required inputs: none.
